title: Sex differences, functional logic, and symmetry in sagittal bone volume of the infrazygomatic crest
html: We read with great interest the article titled “Bone availability in the sagittal dimension of the infrazygomatic crest for miniscrew insertion: A retrospective cone-beam computed tomography study”.1 This study is the first to assess bone availability in the infrazygomatic crest (IZC) for temporary skeletal anchorage device placement from a 45° sagittal perspective and to explore the effects of age, sex, and bilateral symmetry. After carefully reviewing the entire dataset, particularly conducting item-by-item cross-comparisons of the results, we have formulated the following observations for scholarly exchange.
